description: An admin deletes a confirmed pitch booking.
An admin approves a pitch booking request, creating a confirmed booking.
An admin declines a pitch booking request.
A manager or admin submits a request to book a pitch.
An admin takes their club's site live from the Customise page, making it visible to everyone.
A new club is registered on the platform; the signing-up user becomes its admin.
An admin makes their club's site private again, so only the club's admins can see its pages.
A save from the Site Admin page failed. Paired with a $exception carrying the cause.
An admin successfully saved the club's content from the Site Admin page.
An admin bulk-imports upcoming home fixtures from the club feed, auto-creating pending booking requests.
A GoCardless mandate webhook. The suffix is the GoCardless action (created, submitted, active, cancelled, expired, failed, reinstated, consumed).
A GoCardless payment webhook. The suffix is the GoCardless action (created, submitted, confirmed, paid_out, failed, cancelled, surcharge_fee_debited).
A GoCardless subscription webhook. The suffix is the GoCardless action (created, payment_created, customer_approval_granted, cancelled, finished).
A sign-in attempt did not succeed. The reason property distinguishes rejected credentials, a wrong-club account, and a thrown error.
A user signed in successfully.
A player's GoCardless payment is confirmed and a subscription created.
A duplicate GoCardless mandate was detected and cancelled during payment setup.
A GoCardless payment or subscription creation failed during the confirm step.
A player submitted their FAN on the public payment entry page.
An admin creates a GoCardless payment link for a player.
A player lands on the public payment setup page — the top of the subscription payment funnel.
An admin marks a player's payment as inactive.
An admin undoes a manual payment override, putting the registration back to outstanding.
An admin records a registration as paid outside Direct Debit — cash, bank transfer or a sponsored place.
An admin retries creating a GoCardless subscription for an existing mandate.
An admin bulk-imports players from a spreadsheet, creating or updating player registrations and user accounts.
An admin previews unsaved customisation changes on the live site.
An admin updates the club's registration page items.
An admin exports the registrations table to a spreadsheet.
An account creation attempt did not succeed. The reason property distinguishes a rejected request from a thrown error.
A new user account was created.
An admin creates a new subscription level for a club.
An admin deletes a subscription level from the club.
An admin updates the name, price, or interval of an existing subscription level.
An admin maps a registration status (or team + status) to a subscription level, setting the payment rate for that cohort.
An admin removes a status-based subscription rate mapping (club-wide or per-team override).
An admin assigns a coach, manager, or subscriber role on a team.
An admin removes a user's team role assignment.
A user subscribes to follow a team.
A user unsubscribes from following a team.
An admin updates another user's platform role.
